definitions.explanation: A stand or platform from which a speaker delivers a speech or presentation. Can refer to either the raised platform or the stand that holds notes.

examples.japanese: {校長|こうちょう}{先生|せんせい}が{演台|えんだい}の{前|まえ}で{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: The principal gave a greeting from the podium.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}しながら{演台|えんだい}に{上|あ}がったが、{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めると{落|お}ち{着|つ}いてきた。
examples.english: I nervously stepped up to the podium, but once I started speaking, I calmed down.

notes:
USAGE:
{演台|えんだい} is composed of {演|えん} (performance, speech) and {台|だい} (stand, platform). It refers to the physical lectern or podium where a speaker stands.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {壇上|だんじょう} — on the platform/stage (refers to the elevated area, not the lectern)
- {講壇|こうだん} — lecture platform, pulpit

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演台|えんだい}に{立|た}つ (stand at the podium)
- {演台|えんだい}に{上|あ}がる (step up to the podium)
- {演台|えんだい}から{離|はな}れる (leave the podium)
- {演台|えんだい}を{設置|せっち}する (set up a podium)
